raw_market.question: 2Q Spread: Cardinals (-6.5)
raw_market.description:
In the second quarter of the NFL game between Lions and Cardinals, scheduled for October 11 at 4:25 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Cardinals" if the Cardinals outscore the Lions by 7 or more points in the second quarter.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Lions".

Only points scored during that period count; overtime is not included.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
